name: GetResource
source: lane AF: 0x54a770 and 0x54a6b0 look a resource up by key (type, group, instance, 0) and interface id; the answer is a byte

name: GetCount
source: lane AF: 0x54a6b0 compares the index with it (signed)

name: GetValue
source: lane AF: 0x54a6b0 stores the 16-bit result; 0x512860 sign-extends it and divides by 100

name: GetDefinitionKey
source: lane AF: 0x512860 passes a 12-byte buffer and hands the returned pointer to the known-object set's slot 9

name: GetKnownObjects
source: lane AF: the cached service in game global 0x10cc45c (service ids 0x4a037ee3, 0x49ff7d6f); 0x512860 asks it for the set the stack object's definition key is looked up in

name: Contains
source: lane AF: 0x512860 tests the stack object's 12-byte definition key

name: GetSelection
source: lane AF: the cached singleton in game global 0x10cc288; 0x512860 indexes its 4 x 4 table with the two levels of the returned object (null: factor 1)

name: GetFirstLevel
source: lane AF: 0x512860: the row of the table (times four)

name: GetSecondLevel
source: lane AF: 0x512860: the column of the table

name: IsScoreRecordingOn
source: lane AF: the person's +0x40 object; when set, the search keeps a ScoreRecord for every action it scores (and the choice keeps the extra records sorted), 0x5150d0 and 0x515c80 test it

name: GetRandom
source: lane AF: the person's +0x48 object; 0x5150d0 draws the rank of the action to take from the generator it returns (cRZRandom::RandomUint32Uniform, 0x1b8d5c, one argument)

name: PicksBestOnly
source: lane AF: 0x5150d0 draws a random rank among the best only when it is clear; 0x516160 lowers the score threshold from 0.2 to 0.05 when it is set

name: Destroy
source: lane AF: 0x526b40 closes the trace file by calling it with 1 (the deleting destructor)

name: GetHost
source: lane AF: interface 0x5a6216f6 of an object that forwards primitives; AD's use counter code calls the same slot

name: GetMainObject
source: lane AF: the object whose id and counters stand for the forwarding object

name: IsAutonomyEnabled
source: lane AF: 0x515940 only starts a search when it is clear or one of the other conditions holds

name: IsAutonomyForced
source: lane AF: the last of the conditions 0x515940 tests before it starts a search

name: SetSearching
source: lane AF: 0x515940 calls it with 1 when a search has begun

name: IsInputBlocked
source: lane AF: the person's +0x48 object; 0x515940 refuses to start a search while it says yes

name: GetOption
source: lane AF: the person's +0x2c8 object; 0x515940 asks for option 0x1e

name: GetTick
source: lane AF: the person's +0x2c8 object; the search stores it in the person (+0x304) and compares it later

name: GetOwnEntry
source: lane AF: the person's +0x48 object; the person's own table entry, which 0x515c80 also passes to the check-tree runner as its recorder; 0x516160 scores against it instead of the interaction's entry for gathered, pre-checked interactions

name: GetEntryIndex
source: lane AF: the entry's index in its table (an action record's +2); the whole register is compared with the recent-action memory, the low word stored

name: GetNameString
source: lane AF: a cIGZString; 0x515c80 copies it into the rejected record's name

name: IsSelfUsable
source: lane AF: 0x516c40 skips an interaction on the person itself unless its entry says yes

name: GetTableAds
source: lane AF: fills the caller's vector of cTSTreeTableAd and returns it; 0x516160 moves it into the score record (+0x2c)

name: GetTraitAds
source: lane AF: fills the caller's vector of vectors of cTSTraitAdValue and returns it; 0x516160 moves it into the score record (+0x38)

name: RecordUse
source: lane AF: 0x516c40 calls it for every interaction it accepts for scoring, after slot 74 said no

name: WasRecentlyUsed
source: lane AF: 0x516c40 skips the interaction when it says yes

name: GetRecentFactor
source: lane AF: the score factor 0x516160 uses for an action the Sim started lately

name: GetArguments
source: lane AF: points at the interaction's tree argument words (eight bytes are copied into the action record)

name: AllowsInterruption
source: lane AF: 0x516c40: a current interaction that allows it can be replaced by an interrupt

name: IsInterrupt
source: lane AF: 0x516c40: needs a current interaction that allows interruption

name: GetNameString
source: lane AF: a cIGZString (slot 6 data, slot 7 length) the action record's name is built from

name: GetGroupObject
source: lane AF: its id goes into the action record (+0x10); null: 0

name: GetParameters
source: lane AF: 0x516160 passes the addresses of the action record's +0xc then +8

name: IsAvailable
source: lane AF: 0x516160 keeps the object the person scores with (+0x828) only while it says yes, else uses the person

name: GetPersonFactor
source: lane AF: the last factor of the action score (0x516160)

name: UsesTableAds
source: lane AF: 0x516160: set: no skill bonus and the score record gets the entry's table ads; clear: the trait ads (AD's code calls it the counting flag)

name: GetKindList
source: lane AF: the person's +0x40 object; 0x516c40 and Prim03 look the kind (Person Data 0x1f) up in it

name: GetKind
source: lane AF: the entry for a kind; the second argument is always 1 (Prim03's code pushes it as part of the previous call)

name: GetPreferences
source: lane AF: the table 0x516160 reads the Sim's skill columns from (SimRowTable: slot 5 column count, slot 9 cell)

name: GetCategory
source: lane AF: sign-extended into the score record (+0x14) and compared with the recent-action memory

name: IsVetoed
source: lane AF: 0x515c80 rejects an interaction that passed its check when this is set

name: GetDistance
source: lane AF: the score divides by distance * scale + 1; stored in the action record (+0x2c)

name: ForcesChoice
source: lane AF: stored in the action record (+0x12); ChooseAction takes the best action instead of a random one when the best record has it set

name: GetInteractionFactor
source: lane AF: a score factor (the score record's +0x0c)

name: GetObjectBonus
source: lane AF: the score multiplies by 1 + this (the score record's +0x08)

name: GetDistanceScale
source: lane AF: called with tuning 0x1014404 (10.0); the action record's +0x28

name: GetMotiveTime
source: lane AF: the person's +0x60c object; stored as the search time (+0x308) and subtracted in the score

name: ScoreEntry
source: lane AF: the table entry's motive score; the action record's +0x24 and the first term of the score

name: CopySnapshot
source: lane AF: fills the person's second snapshot (+0x3ac) when a search starts

name: Prepare
source: lane AF: 0x516e00 calls it with the tree owner when a tree's cached flags are not known yet, then reads the flags (slot 16) again

name: RequiresMinimumScore
source: lane AF: 0x515270 refuses an action scoring below tuning 0x1014514 when it is non-zero
